title: Abstract proper Kunneth normalization diagram
statement: For categories D,E, functors F,G:D→E and eta:F⇒G, take objects U,X,X′,X″,Z,H,H′ in E and V,V′,W,Q in D. Take maps s:U→X, r:X→F(V), i:V→W, k:F(W)→H, ch:H→H′, c:W→Q, cmp:G(Q)→H′, v:V→V′, t:V′→Q, b:X→X′, r′:X′→G(V), d:X′→X″, r″:X″→G(V′), input:U→Z, s′:Z→X″ and kappa:Z→H′. If k;ch=F(c);eta_Q;cmp, i;c=v;t, r;eta_V=b;r′, r′;G(v)=d;r″, s;b;d=input;s′ and s′;r″;G(t);cmp=kappa, then (s;r;F(i);k);ch=input;kappa. No invertibility or geometric hypotheses are assumed.

proof.text: Reassociate the composite, substitute hc and combine the two F-images. Use hi and naturality of eta, then hp. Expand the G-image of the composite; apply hn and hs under the common tail. Finish with hk. All steps are composition associativity, functoriality and naturality in Mathlib.

proof_origin.place: Elementary diagram calculation of the proper forget-supports normalization

mathlib_searches.query: Functor.map_comp_assoc; NatTrans.naturality_assoc in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.Category and NatTrans
mathlib_searches.results: The standard functoriality, naturality and associativity equations suffice. This lemma bundles their six given squares without a new mathematical assumption.

mathlib_searches.query: Category theory diagram chase: a composite under functors F and G related by a natural transformation, substituting six commutative squares using naturality and functoriality
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results, including CatCommSq, TwoSquare, NatTrans.mapSquare and CatCommSq component/naturality equations. These package functor squares rather than this six-equation morphism calculation.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the elementary Mathlib composition and naturality equations directly.

mathlib_searches.results: One exact hit in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.NatTrans. Its reassociated naturality equation is used in the proof.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Used together with functoriality and the six given square equations.

lean.statement:
theorem properKunnethNormalizationAlgebra
    {D E : Type v} [Category.{u} D] [Category.{u} E]
    (F G : D ⥤ E) (eta : F ⟶ G)
    {U X X' X'' Z H H' : E} {V V' W Q : D}
    (s : U ⟶ X) (r : X ⟶ F.obj V) (i : V ⟶ W)
    (k : F.obj W ⟶ H) (ch : H ⟶ H')
    (c : W ⟶ Q) (cmp : G.obj Q ⟶ H')
    (v : V ⟶ V') (t : V' ⟶ Q)
    (b : X ⟶ X') (r' : X' ⟶ G.obj V)
    (d : X' ⟶ X'') (r'' : X'' ⟶ G.obj V')
    (input : U ⟶ Z) (s' : Z ⟶ X'') (kappa : Z ⟶ H')
    (hc : k ≫ ch = F.map c ≫ eta.app Q ≫ cmp)
    (hi : i ≫ c = v ≫ t)
    (hp : r ≫ eta.app V = b ≫ r')
    (hn : r' ≫ G.map v = d ≫ r'')
    (hs : s ≫ b ≫ d = input ≫ s')
    (hk : s' ≫ r'' ≫ G.map t ≫ cmp = kappa) :
    (s ≫ r ≫ F.map i ≫ k) ≫ ch = input ≫ kappa
